name: Angelyn Bonaldy
aboutMe: Hello! I'm Angely, a full-stack developer with a unique background in health and wellness. After 13 years as a nutritionist, my curiosity to implement technological solutions led me to train as a web developer, specializing in React, Node, Postgres, and SQL.
aboutMe2: My previous experience has equipped me with strong communication skills, a solution-oriented mindset, creativity, and empathy, enabling me to foster effective collaboration in development teams.
aboutMe3: When I'm not immersed in the coding world, I enjoy exercising, dancing, and diving into the pages of a good book. I'm passionate about the challenges presented by programming and love finding innovative solutions to complex problems.
aboutMe4: I currently reside in Barcelona, where I'm inspired by the vibrant tech community and the cultural richness this city has to offer.
aboutMe5: I'm excited about the future opportunities and challenging projects that programming has in store for me!

projects.name: Alejandra Mercado Duran - Nutritionist
projects.description: I developed a professional website for a nutritionist using Astro for optimal performance. With a responsive design focused on user experience, the site offers personalized consultations and a detailed professional profile. Technology and wellness in one place!

projects.name: Nutrition and Wellness Web
projects.description: A platform under development for personalized nutrition consultations and training. It integrates WhatsApp bookings, testimonials, and recipes, designed with React and Astro for a seamless experience. A project that combines health and technology!

projects.name: MigraMix
projects.description: In a world where art knows no borders, MigraMix emerges as a digital haven for migrant artists. It’s a platform that promotes migrant artists and their events. Developed with React, Node.js, and PostgreSQL, it connects communities through art. A project that unites cultures and celebrates diversity!

projects.name: Patitas
projects.description: A platform that connects animal shelters with people willing to adopt. Developed with React and Tailwind, Patitas is more than a website: it’s a bridge to loving homes for our furry friends.

projects.name: Portfolio
projects.description: Welcome to my digital world, where every project is a story to tell. My portfolio reflects my passion for web development. With React and Tailwind, I’ve created a space where creativity and functionality merge. Explore my projects and discover how I bring ideas to life!

projects.name: GoodFood
projects.description: A recipe search engine with nutritional information, developed with React and an external API. GoodFood not only inspires in the kitchen but also helps make healthy decisions. Technology at the service of food!
